'''Lu'bratnik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[biochemist]]ry living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he managed a small shop, also teaching his knowledge to others.
